sections.h2: Glenwood Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 186 residential sales closed in Glenwood (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $452,500, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 15 days to sell, about the same pace as the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Glenwood sales closed between $335,750 and $490,000, or about $230 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($460,000, 90 sales) was about 6% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($435,500, 96 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Most recent Glenwood sales were in ZIP code 23456, with a meaningful share in 23464.

72% of sales here were detached homes, versus 61% citywide. 43% of Glenwood homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so competing offers were more common than in the typical neighborhood. 1% of the homes sold here were built in 2015 or later; across Virginia Beach the figure is 7%.

sections.h2: When Glenwood Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Glenwood were busiest in July (28 sales across the two years) and slowest in March (9 sales). Sold prices ran from $154,600 to $660,000, a spread of 4.3x between the lowest and highest sale. 81% of homes closed at or above list price and 4% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Glenwood
sections.html:
72% of the sales were detached homes and 28% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,849 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,440 to 2,191 square feet. 42% of the homes that sold had 4 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1988 and 1995, with a median year built of 1990, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
